versions.changelog:
Nano Banana Pro Prompts Recommendation skill – version 0.1.0

- Recommends AI image generation prompts sourced from a 26,000+ community-curated prompt library, optimized for Nano Banana Pro (Gemini) but compatible with all major text-to-image models.
- Every prompt recommendation now includes a mandatory sample image for user preview, using images hosted on HuggingFace.
- Supports two modes: direct image prompt recommendation or content illustration based on provided article/script/text.
- Efficient token and file access strategies—prompts are searched line-by-line and never fully loaded into memory.
- Automatic reference freshness check updates the prompt library if it's older than 24 hours.
- Mandatory attribution footer is included with every response, supporting English and Chinese users.
